name: io.github.Servosity/crowdstrike-mcp
title: CrowdStrike MCP
description: Every CrowdStrike Falcon MSP operation, plus a Flight-Control-aware local store that answers

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the CrowdStrike Falcon API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional OAuth2 scope for the token request. Leave blank: CrowdStrike grants scopes to the API client in the Falcon console.

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank: the client ID and secret are posted to /oauth2/token on the cloud named by the base URL. Set it only for a non-standard token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: FALCON_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the FALCON_CLIENT_ID credential for the CrowdStrike MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the CrowdStrike MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to credentials.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every write from the MCP server (read tools only).

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses (reads go to the API; the response cache is off).

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on CrowdStrike requests.

environmentVariables.name: CROWDSTRIKE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (at least 32 characters). Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
